issues.quote: up 9 percent from $96.8 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Going from $96.8B to $97.7B is about 0.9% growth, roughly 1%, not 9%. Tesla reported about 1% year-over-year revenue growth for 2024.

data.summary: Revenue ($97.7B vs. $96.8B), net income (about $7.1B), operating income (about $7.1B), total assets (about $122.1B) and cash and cash equivalents (about $16.1B) all match what Tesla reported for FY2024. The only error is the growth rate: it was about 1%, not 9%.
